paper_id: Liu et al. - 2007 - Defending P2Ps from Overlay Flooding-based DDoS
title: Defending P2Ps from Overlay Flooding-based DDoS
motivation: P2P flooding搜索导致少量恶意节点可放大攻击消耗整个系统资源
problem_framing: Overlay DDoS攻击目标不是单个站点而是整个P2P系统
key_insight: 通过邻居协作监控与双重指标(g/s)识别恶意节点并隔离
method_signature: DD-POLICE分布式流量监控+Buddy Group协作+指标阈值判决
evaluation_criteria: 查询成功率/响应时间/流量开销/损伤恢复时间/误判率
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 预防方法无法阻止P2P中大量代理被招募；cut threshold存在漏判与误判的权衡
evidence_for_taste: most previous techniques...cannot be applied to overlay DDoS
only tens of DDoS agents in a 20,000-peer system cause serious damage
The tradeoff is that the damage...but some good peers may be miscounted
a small number of messages are inherently propagated to consume...resources
hard to separate attack query traffic from legitimate traffic
thinking_moves: 从网络层防御失效反推需要overlay层专属方案
通过实现真实DDoS agent理解攻击者能力边界
把邻居协作检测框定为信息交换+指标计算问题
用阈值敏感性分析指导参数选择(CT=5或6)
先量化攻击危害程度再验证防御有效性
extraction_notes: 论文缺少完整venue信息；Section编号存在跳跃(5->4->5)可能是排版问题
